steps.title: Establish Project Configuration
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with target SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and compile-time specifications matching the GitHub Actions environment.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Establish the AndroidManifest.xml structure utilizing valid namespaces, target activities, hardware sensors, and application details.

steps.title: Modernize Die Board Asset Drawables
steps.description: Design sleek 3D layered rounded shapes and deep bezel definitions for die containers to give a realistic, premium board game rendering.

steps.title: Modernize Die Face Dot Drawables
steps.description: Define beautiful gradient circle shape templates for dots rendered inside active dice faces.

steps.title: Create High-Fidelity Button and Card UI Components
steps.description: Generate modern gradient-based button background selectors, press behaviors, and translucent glassmorphic card background frames using advanced XML layer-lists.

steps.title: Configure Premium Tab Selectors & Colors
steps.description: Provide custom interactive states and high-contrast color selectors for navigation tabs to denote active and inactive options clearly.

steps.title: Create Real-time PCM Sound Synthesizer
steps.description: Preserve the robust AudioTrack processing class in Java to synthesize physical dice clattering sounds and triumphant victory chimes on-the-fly without requiring external audio assets.

steps.title: Develop Premium and Modernized XML User Interface Layout
steps.description: Assemble highly polished and premium UI panels for Solo Roller, two-player Battle Mode, Jeopardy Pig Game, and persistent statistics board with excellent spacing and rich color contrast.

steps.title: Bind UI Elements & Multi-Tab Routing
steps.description: Initialize view binding in MainActivity.java to link classic rolling, battle arenas, and settings tabs dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Randomizer & Physics Rolling Simulator
steps.description: Animate physical states using cycles before outputting final results to simulate realistic rolling mechanics.

steps.title: Develop Accelerometer Shake-to-Roll Handler
steps.description: Integrate standard Android SensorEventListener logic with real-time vector calculations and custom debounce filters.

steps.title: Program Solo Mode and Battle Engine
steps.description: Maintain advanced gaming state logic supporting multiple counts, scoreboard aggregation, high scores, and persistent roll frequencies.

steps.title: Program Jeopardy Pig Game Engine
steps.description: Maintain strategic jeopardy game loops with roll, hold, and turn points penalty configurations for Player 1 and Player 2.

steps.title: Implement Style & Theme Customization Layer
steps.description: Deliver a seamless style switcher utilizing high-contrast primary color triggers (Casino Green, Indigo Night, Onyx Black) based on user selections.

steps.title: Building Dice Master Pro
steps.description: Synthesize resources and execute project compilation verifying absolute stability and error-free builds.
